t: This is St Peter's School, a former school at 38 St Oswald's Place in Vauxhall. It was designed by John Loughborough Pearson, a Gothic Revival architect renowned for his churches and cathedrals. He worked on at least two hundred and ten ecclesiastical buildings in England over a career of fifty-four years, and was especially skilled at vaulting. A school is a less usual commission for him, which makes this building a small curiosity in his career.
